'''Jaluka Jianga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Hermit/Legends|hermit]] who lived on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:P" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer working for [[Palo/Legends|Palo]],<ref name="SWG:P" /> a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]],<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> defended Jaluka Jianga who was attacked by an [[Ikopi/Legends|ikopi]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]].<ref name="SWG:P" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaluka Jianga was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Jaluka Jianga was involved in the second quest given by Palo on Naboo. However, these quests were bugged and lacked any text dialogue strings, rendering it impossible to have derived much context from them.<ref name="SWG:P" /><ref name="NabooMap">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=55618.html|text=Attach to the Labeled Naboo Map: All Static missions for Naboo}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref> Palo and related characters such as Jaluka Jianga were eventually removed from the game by its developers relatively early in the game's lifespan.
